thread:
Asha: FYI — Prospect ClearGate wants a short POC to swap CompetitorZ for Redwood. Main asks: compat layer, token accounting differences, security questionnaire, and a committed-capacity price check. Kickoff in ~10 days.
Tom: Noted. Technical priorities: streaming semantics (they stream partial deltas), stop-sequence behavior, and our function-calling shape vs theirs. We usually offer a compatibility shim.
Priya: For token accounting: remind them our tokenizer differs; we can provide a token-delta report sample. Also confirm how we bill when clients use streaming vs non-streaming (we bill emitted tokens).
Marco: Security will want SOC2 scope, data retention/deletion API, CMEK support, and private deployment lead time. I'll prepare short answers and the standard attestation link.
Asha: Can we propose a 10-business-day POC: days 1-3 integration, 4-7 parity checks + fixes, 8-10 perf/smoke and handoff? Want to hand them a runbook and a mini smoke harness.
Tom: I can package a tiny shim and a smoke script that runs ~30 prompts and diffs responses (whitespace normalize, JSON canonicalize, and cosine similarity on embeddings). Will include examples for stop-token edge cases.
Priya: I'll generate a 10-prompt token-delta table and include an explanation of expected variance (+/- ~5-12% on typical conversational prompts). Also include billing examples for 100M tokens/mo committed.
Marco: Security notes to include in questionnaire answers:
- SOC2: in-scope (link)
- KMS: AWS/GCP/Azure CMEK supported
- Audit logs: 90d default, S3 export available
- Private deploy: VPC/on-prem options; ~3-6 week lead time
- Pen-test: 2-week coordination window
sec-bot: Reminder: attach SOC2 attestation PDF and contact sec-eng@redwood.ai for pen-test scheduling.
Asha: Action items recap:
- Tom: shim + smoke harness (docker + README) -> due Fri 11:00
- Marco: questionnaire answers + attestation link -> due Mon EOD
- Priya: token-delta sheet + pricing sketch for 100M -> due Mon 14:00
- Asha: POC runbook + NDA -> due Mon EOD
Tom: Will also add a short note about model fallbacks and routing (if capacity constrained we can route to a cheaper quantized variant).
Priya: On pricing ballpark: hosted list ~ $0.0045 / 1k tokens; committed 12mo could be ~20% off. I'll confirm with RevOps.
Asha: Great. I'll send an intro email to ClearGate and propose the POC timeline once we have the runbook draft. Ping here if any blockers.
